findings.text: The driver wrote at 10:04 that a red warning came on, the car felt different when accelerating, and they had stopped.
The driver says at 11:02 they are OK at Hollenmark services, A7 northbound, about 40 km south of Hannover, engine off, and have sent the dashboard photo in the app.
The last GPS reading, stale, at 07:00 CEST showed 233 km to go to Hamburg and an app ETA of 13:13 CEST; GPS gives no map position, so the driver's location is their claim.
Marvellin Motorhandel wrote at 10:40 to keep the car stopped while they ask their service contact whether it needs roadside assistance or collection.
The delivery promise is Wed 21 Oct 12:00–16:00 CEST at Marvellin Hamburg.
Kellerbrook Recovery (24-hour, flatbed for low cars) can be there in about 52 min: about €215 to their workshop or about €810 to the Hamburg delivery address, quotes, not booked.
